purpose: Concrete outer supervisor launch form for fresh-audit checking only. Root may source-write this launcher; it grants no execution authority by itself and accesses no private path except through the reviewed operator.

bounds.outerClockStart: operator process spawn, including archive staging/extraction
bounds.innerWindow: Native-call window from Runner construction after extraction (operator.py:435,594-599), plus up to 10 s per-call kill cleanup (operator.py:519-535); not a whole-execution cap
bounds.parentHardLimits: Do not cap the timeout/prlimit parent hard AS or CPU below the child limits; only RLIMIT_CORE=0 is imposed by prlimit.

caveats: GNU timeout signals its managed child/prlimit chain; the operator spawns each native call with start_new_session=True (operator.py:513) and bwrap --new-session --die-with-parent (operator.py:468-469), so outer process-group kill is not guaranteed to reach every descendant session.
--die-with-parent ties bwrap children to operator death on a best-effort basis only; no guarantee against unkillable D-state processes.
CPU limits are per-process, not transitive across descendants; total transitive CPU is not capped.
Failure at any bound (outer 180/190 s, inner 120 s, per-call 30 s) leaves the single attempt spent; zero retries.
gate: Fresh audit must check this actual launch form. Execution only under a separate actual AUTH with status AUTHORIZED_ONE_RUN after the addendum review and two FOR/AGREE votes on P-29..P-32.
